reviews.title: Least Accurate App
reviews.text: This app can’t tell the difference between a red bud tree and a sweet potato. Not even in the same family.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I’m 100% sure that I bought a lifetime purchase of this some years ago but couldn’t find any record of it and upon contacting support I never heard anything back. So in the end I concluded I must’ve not bought it (although I am confident I did). Either way in the end after getting nowhere with support, I eventually purchased the lifetime option. Upon launching the app I now see there’s a new feature which I don’t have access to because it’s locked behind yet another new tier of paid subscription. So even though I have purchased lifetime access there are now features that I cannot use unless I pay more again. On principle alone, I will be switching to another app.

reviews.title: We shouldn’t pay
reviews.text: Pretty good. We only get a few free pics and then we have to pay

reviews.title: Capture button now worse
reviews.text: When you go to capture a photo the app now makes you select between snapping a photo and using flora live each and every time which is a bad design and extremely annoying for the user. The less taps it takes to perform basic, repetitive app functions the better.

reviews.title: No AI please!
reviews.text: I had this app before they added AI. It was great and doesn’t need AI. 😩

reviews.title: Not what I had hoped for
reviews.text:
I am looking for an app where I can add all the plants in my garden, and add in the details that I want about care, flowering time etc. I also wanted to be able to record photos occasionally so that I can see how a plant looks at different times of year, or log comments about the progress. 
The app seems to work well on the logging side, which is what made me get it. However I am disappointed in the fact that once I have added my plants they just appear in a list in the order they were added. I cannot re-sort at all, or even search for a particular plant so this will make logging anything virtually impossible. As such, it makes the app pretty useless to me& so I will have to continue my search for something that meets my needs

reviews.title: Not working
reviews.text: Never gets to actually identify a plant.    Picture disappears and screen goes all white !!!

reviews.title: Absolute rubbish
reviews.text: Bought it half price. Worst purchase ever. Apart from something obvious like a lavender in full bloom it couldn’t recognise any plant I showed it whether indoor or outdoor, in bloom or not. Save your money. £20 quid down the drain. Cancelled the renewal already. Utter waste of time

reviews.title: Old version better
reviews.text: For the last year I’ve used this app and loved it. It was accurate and easily pulled up the info that I found helpful about a plant. The new version is so much harder to use free (and I’m sure are making ad revenue) and it clunky and doesn’t pull the most helpful info on the plant description. So disappointing. Unless they revert back to the old version I’ll likely be moving to a new app.
